title: Ray-Tracing Transepithelial Excimer Laser Central Corneal Remodeling Plus Pachymetry-Guided Accelerated Corneal Crosslinking for Keratoconus

groups.description: Worst eye of young adult patients (26-46 years) with stable stage II keratoconus treated with same-day ray-tracing-guided transepithelial PRK (central corneal remodelling) plus epithelium-off pachymetry-guided accelerated cross-linking (M nomogram, 9-30 mW/cm2, 5.4 J/cm2) (Methods)

series.notes: Table 2 means without SD; the number of eyes at the 4-year visit is not reported (follow-up 12-96 months, mean 52); Kmax measured with the Sirius tomographer (Methods)

exclusions.reason: figure only; the table cells are cited

notes: Single-arm prospective interventional study; the combined protocol is the only group, so role control (no experimental arm declared against a comparator).
Group size: Methods and Abstract give 38 eyes of 38 patients, the Table 1 header gives 40 eyes of 40 patients; n = 38 from the Methods.
The Results text gives a preoperative mean Kmax that differs from Tables 1 and 2; the tabulated cell is cited.
Inclusion required stable keratoconus during the previous year (Kmax variation of at most 1 D); half of the patients were asked to stop rubbing their eyes.
UCVA, CDVA, coma, tomographic cylinder, minimum corneal thickness, mean pupil power, posterior elevation (Table 2) and endothelial cell count (Table 1) are tabulated and not used.
